coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Potrero Power Station Block 14
record.summary: Small planned mixed-use block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a flat 90 ft height limit; program not confirmed beyond the D4D's generic use table, and no design review approval or construction start found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- this block is not yet built and does not correspond to any subdivided Assessor parcel: it currently sits on vacant/graded land within the former power station site (unaddressed in DataSF's Assessor roll). Traced from an adopted regulatory diagram via multi-point real-street georeferencing (see digitization_method), but this diagram is dated 2020 and may not reflect later design changes (as already found for the UCSF/Sophie Maxwell area -- see digitization_method). Treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 10-25m, not survey-grade, and treat the block's applicability itself as somewhat more provisional than Mission Rock's or Pier 70's equivalent entries. Rebuilt 2026-09-16 via GDAL GCP/TPS georeferencing, then corrected same-day after a mis-traced chamfer corner was caught by this project's geometry-quality check -- see digitization_method. This block's NE corner is genuinely angled (chamfered) per the source diagram, not a tracing artifact -- do not treat that corner's non-90-degree angle as an error.
notes.digitized_from: Potrero Power Station Design for Development, Figure 6.2.3 - Building Height Plan (p.245).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor parcel may exist under this block (part of the site's larger, largely unaddressed footprint), but it has not been subdivided per the masterplan's individual named blocks -- this uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead.
notes.regulatory_context: Flat 90 ft max height per Figure 6.2.3. Program/use not independently confirmed by any source found beyond this figure; recorded here as 'mixed' as a neutral default rather than guessing a specific use.

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail and Non-Retail Sales/Services uses permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)
flat 90 ft max per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3

milestones.text: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 14 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 14; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.
No source found for a specific intended use of Block 14 beyond the D4D's generic permitted-uses table; it is the smallest block on the site per the D4D's own Land Use Plan figure.
No phase-specific schedule found for Block 14; the added expected-completion milestone therefore uses only the whole-project buildout target (2035, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a block-specific date.
